name: Yoppli Video Player Design
author: yoppli

sections.description:
Yoppli Video Player Design
Documentation & PRO Masterclass
Welcome to the most advanced video engine for WordPress. Discover how to combine tools to create foolproof marketing strategies, monetize with ads, and protect your content like an expert.

Additional Information: Free vs. PRO Version
Video Player Design is built to give you the most elegant and fluid video experience on WordPress. Whether you are running a simple blog or a complex digital business, our player adapts to your needs.

Here is a detailed breakdown of what you get with the Free version and the powerful tools waiting for you in the PRO upgrade:

🟢 FREE VERSION: The Essential Elegance
The free version is perfect for simple blogs, portfolios, or anyone looking to upgrade the boring native WordPress video player instantly.

What’s Included:

Automatic Replacement Engine: Scans your “Posts” and “Pages” and automatically transforms any native .mp4 link or block into our sleek, dark, and fluid player.
Custom Slugs Support: Extend the automatic replacement to your Custom Post Types (like courses, portfolios, or products) by simply adding their slug.
Unified Modern Skin: A clean, dark-themed design that looks professional on any device.
Essential Player Controls: Give your users the mandatory tools they need:
Giant Center Play Button.
Bottom Play/Pause Button.
Fluid Progress Bar & Time Display.
Individual vs. Global Sizing: Choose whether players adapt automatically to their container (100% width) or strictly follow a global size setting across your site.
🚀 PRO VERSION: The Ultimate Video Marketing Engine
Ready to protect your content, monetize with ads, and skyrocket your conversions? The PRO version unlocks a suite of advanced marketing, design, and security tools used by top academies and streaming sites.

Unlock Premium Features:

🎨 Advanced Design & Branding

2 Premium Skins: Completely change the player’s CSS architecture with one click.
Custom Colors: Match the player to your brand by changing the primary color of the progress bar, buttons, and hover effects.
☁️ External Cloud Support & Performance

YouTube White Label: Transform a regular YouTube iframe into a premium player, hiding the red bar, the YT logo, and the annoying end-of-video recommendations.
Amazon S3 Support: Play videos directly from your S3 bucket to save server bandwidth.
Dropbox Support: Play videos hosted on Dropbox effortlessly.
Auto-Thumbnails: Automatically extract a frame from your video to use as a poster image (requires FFmpeg).
🛡️ Content Protection & Engagement

Encrypted Download (Blob): Hide your real video URL from the source code, preventing extensions like IDM from stealing your premium courses.
Hover-to-Play Preview: Emulate Netflix! The video starts playing silently when the user hovers over it, creating an ultra-effective visual hook.
Picture-in-Picture (PiP): Allow users to detach the video into a floating window so they can keep watching while reading your articles.
Double Click Fullscreen: Emulate mobile app behavior for a faster viewing experience.
🛠️ Full Control Bar Mastery

Advanced Tools: Unlock the Volume slider, Fullscreen toggle, Rewind/Forward (10s), Playback Speed control (vital for courses), Video Quality selector (HD/SD), and Subtitles (VTT).
Interactive Features: Let users take a Snapshot (Camera) of the video, Cast to their Smart TVs, or share the video across 8 social networks (including WhatsApp and TikTok).
Aggressive Replace: Force the player to render inside complex visual builders like Elementor or Divi.
💰 Built-in Ad Server & Monetization

Native Ads (Pre/Post Roll): Upload sponsor videos and inject a Visual Info Card with a “Buy Now” CTA pointing to your checkout.
Non-intrusive Banners: Display elegant image strips at the bottom of the video with close buttons and skip timers.
Google AdSense / VAST: Inject AdSense HTML or request dynamic video commercials directly from Google.
Smart Frequency & Budget Control: Show ads based on accumulated watch time and automatically pause campaigns when they hit your exact CPV/CPC budget limit.

🚀 Upgrade Your WordPress Video Experience Instantly
Yoppli Video Player Design is the ultimate solution to transform your boring native WordPress videos into a modern, highly engaging, and conversion-focused media experience. Whether you are running a simple blog, an online academy, or a viral magazine, our player adapts perfectly to your needs.

🔹 What’s included in the FREE Version?
The free version is designed to be lightweight and plug-and-play. It automatically detects your local .mp4 links and WordPress Media Library videos, replacing them with a sleek, modern player.

Unified Modern Skin: Instantly gives your site a premium, dark-mode aesthetic.

Fluid Navigation: Includes a clean progress bar, a giant centered play button, and responsive bottom controls.

Auto-Replacement Engine: Zero coding required. It automatically scans your posts and pages to replace basic WP video shortcodes with the Yoppli Player.

Mobile Ready: 100% responsive and optimized for smartphones and tablets.

⭐ Unlock the Ultimate Power with the PRO Version
Ready to monetize, protect, and scale? Yoppli Video Player Design PRO is the most advanced video engine for WordPress, packed with features used by top streaming platforms, online academies, and digital marketers.

Don’t just show a video—build an entire business ecosystem around it.

💸 Built-in Ad Server (Monetize your videos)
Google AdSense & VAST/IMA: Inject dynamic video commercials or HTML banners directly into your videos.

Native Ads & Ad Pods: Upload your sponsors’ MP4s as Pre-Roll, Mid-Roll, or Post-Roll. You can even chain up to 9 ads in a row!

Smart Watchtime Frequency: Respect your audience. Show ads based on actual minutes watched, rather than spamming them on every page reload.

Advanced Control: Assign CPV/CPC limits to automatically stop campaigns when the budget is reached.

🔒 Cloud Integrations & Anti-Theft Protection
Amazon S3 & Dropbox Support: Host your videos externally and save hundreds of dollars in server bandwidth.

Encrypted Download (Blob): Hide your real video URLs from the source code, protecting your S3 links from hackers and mass-download extensions like IDM.

YouTube White Label: Paste any YouTube link and the player will strip away the red UI, the YouTube logo, and the annoying end-of-video recommendations.

👤 Immersive User Ecosystem
Frontend Dashboard & Avatars: Replace the standard WordPress login with a stunning Glassmorphism popup. Let your users manage multiple profiles with avatars, just like top streaming VOD platforms.

Security Vault (PIN) & KYC: Allow users to protect their sub-profiles with a 4-digit PIN. You can also require document uploads (KYC) to verify identities and award “Verified Badges” from a VIP Audit dashboard.

🎨 10+ Premium Visual Themes
Transform your player with one click: MacOS Glass (floating controls), Neon Gradients, Netflix-style Cinema, or Pure Minimalist. Customize primary and secondary brand colors to perfectly match your site!

🕹️ Advanced UX & Marketing Tools
Hover Preview: The video starts playing silently when users hover over it (Netflix style)—an ultra-effective visual hook.

Smart Pause (Anti-Abandon): Automatically pauses the video if the user switches browser tabs, forcing visual attention (perfect for VSLs and Courses).

Smart Memory: The player remembers exactly where the user left off and resumes seamlessly on their next visit.

Picture-in-Picture (PiP) & Cast to TV: Let users float the video on their screen while reading an article, or cast it directly to their Smart TVs via Chromecast/AppleTV.

Interactive Tools: Double-click for fullscreen, playback speed controls (vital for students), snapshot camera, and WhatsApp/Social sharing buttons.

🔌 Seamless Integrations
Fully compatible with WooCommerce (HPOS), LearnDash, Elementor, Divi, Gutenberg, and 100% translation-ready for Loco Translate and WPML. Our aggressive engine intercepts old shortcodes and transforms them flawlessly within visual builders.

👉 Ready to take your videos to the next level?
Discover the PRO Masterclass, explore business use-cases, and get your license at: https://yoppli.com/yoppli-video-player-design-pro/
